error.message: The loop through MIX3, KREA4, SCDS5 did not converge: at iteration 2, Column SCDS5: the rigorous column did not converge. Tried: Newton from the sum-rates start (temperatures at the bubble points), steps of at most 20 K (12 iterations, 528 ms: the residual fell only from 1.008 to 0.264 in 12 iterations); Newton from the sum-rates start (temperatures from the energy balances), steps of at most 20 K (12 iterations, 1540 ms: the residual fell only from 12.4 to 0.1731 in 12 iterations); continuation in the relative volatilities (stopped at 99.32 % of the way, after 15 steps, 20054 ms). Last residuals: material 7.026 mol/s, equilibrium 0.1061, energy 664000 W, specifications 0. On the last iterate the liquid of stage 7 would split into two liquids: the column may hold two liquids there, which phases "VL" (one liquid) does not represent; turn on "look for two liquids on the stages" (phases "VLL", activity models). This does not show that the column has no solution: try other feeds (more liquid or less gas), more stages, other feed stages, or stage duties that remove the heat of absorption.. What usually helps: a purge or a smaller recycle fraction (a recycle with no way out keeps growing), a guess for the tear stream (S7) close to the answer, another tear stream, another convergence method, or more iterations.
